description:
Trading competitions of YOUR platform (white-label): without competition_id the
    list (name, chain, metric, status, start and end, participants); with it the
    rules, every rule change and the current standings with your own user ids
    (standings are recomputed every 5 minutes, final once ended). Use for "Who is
    leading the competition?" or "Which competitions are running?".

    Needs your own CabalSpy API key with a CabalSpy ID instance (no demo).

competition_id.description: A competition id from a previous call. Empty lists your competitions; set it for the rules and the standings.
competition_id.title: Competition Id

instance.description: Your CabalSpy ID instance (its client_id, e.g. 'csid_1a2b…'). Only needed when your account has several instances. Leave empty otherwise.
instance.title: Instance

limit.description: How many competitions or standings rows (1-50, default 10).
limit.title: Limit

status.description: When listing: scheduled, waiting, running, ended or cancelled. Empty lists all.
status.title: Status

name: csid_competitions
